notes: Signatures for ATS application forms (design 4.5; FEATURES-OTP-ACCOUNTS-CAPTCHA 2.6). A social sign-in page, an SMS, phone, authenticator or identity check trips the ATS breaker (ats_security): these are never handled by code. A visible CAPTCHA, an account wall or an email-code page trips no breaker: the verdict is stop for this job only (trip false, job_needs_human names the job set-status reason). handoff captcha opens the owner's CAPTCHA task. capability names the per-site consent (private/consent.json capabilities) under which a job-level stop does not apply (detect answers clear with a flow); a capability key on a tripping signature is a load error, so no data edit can turn a tripping stop off. Tripping signatures rank before job-level ones, so a page that matches both always stops. HTTP 429 trips the ats scope. Same regex rules as linkedin.json.
